headline: Uzbekistan and Oman announce elevation of relations to strategic partnership level
summary: Uzbekistan and Oman decided to elevate relations to a strategic partnership, announced during talks in Muscat between Shavkat Mirziyoyev and Sultan Haitham bin Tariq Al Said. Cooperation across various sectors was discussed.
why: Strategic partnerships between Gulf states and Central Asian economies can broaden trade, investment and energy-related cooperation over time.
original_headline: O‘zbekiston va O‘mon munosabatlarni strategik sheriklik darajasiga olib chiqqanini e’lon qildi
